```{r echo=FALSE,include=TRUE}
Vs30_TARGET <- SHT$Vs30 |> unique() 
PGA_TARGET <- UHSTable[TR==TR_TARGET & Vref==760 &Vs30 %in% Vs30_TARGET & p==p_TARGET & Tn==0 & ID=="nrc_v3.19.1"]$PGA |> unique()
Caption <- CAP  |> sprintf(TR_TARGET,min(Vs30_TARGET),max(Vs30_TARGET),min(PGA_TARGET),max(PGA_TARGET),p_TARGET)
# Caption <- ""
DATA <- KIT[TR==TR_TARGET & p == p_TARGET,.(ID=Name,Y=Kh,X=Da)][order(X)]|> unique()

PLOT <- buildPlot(
  library = "highcharter",
  yAxis.label =TRUE,
  plot.type="spline",
  point.size = 0.1,
  legend.layout="horizontal",
  legend.show=TRUE,
  xAxis.log = TRUE,
  yAxis.log = TRUE,
  line.size=THICK_LINE_SIZE,
  xAxis.legend="Da [cm]",
  yAxis.legend="Kh [% PGA]",
  group.legend="Facility",
  data=DATA,
  plot.subtitle = Caption)
PLOT
```
